species.name: Scorchbun

dex.text: A black lump on a dead ash branch that looks burnt, isn't burnt, and gets very upset if you say it's burnt. It is still warm. Nobody knows why.
dex.fact: King Alfred's cakes are named after the cakes Alfred is said to have let burn while hiding on the Somerset Levels; they're also called cramp balls, once carried to ward off cramp.

species.real: Cut a King Alfred's cake in half and it shows rings inside, a bit like a tree's. Dried, it smoulders for hours, so people once carried it as tinder.

dex.text: Larger, blacker and smouldering with real intent. Has stopped claiming it is not burnt and now simply asks whether you are cold.
dex.fact: Dried King Alfred's cakes smoulder slowly, so people used them as tinder to carry a spark from place to place.
